screen: Desktop guide topic 'Off Grid AI on your phone' and phone guide topic 'Off Grid AI on your computer'
title: Other-device topics offer only a web link
what: Both topics promise pairing ('Pair with your computer to share chats', 'Paired, your phone uses its models'). The only action is 'Get it', a web URL. On the phone it opens the desktop download page on the phone. No topic offers Devices, Sync, Remote servers or a QR to install.
risk: A user who already has both apps cannot get from the guide to pairing. A phone user is sent to a desktop download on a device that cannot install it.
rec: shared: add a second action per topic: desktop 'phone' opens Devices (pair QR); mobile 'computer' opens Remote servers > Scan network or Sync. Show 'Get it' only when no paired device is known.

screen: Desktop guide: 'Voice' topic and 'Voice mode on the phone' topic
title: Desktop guide sells voice mode as phone Pro
what: Feature parts make voice mode free on desktop (voice-mode tier desktop: free, guide desktop: 'chat'). The desktop chat topic never mentions talking or answers aloud. The desktop guide shows 'Voice mode on the phone' (Pro, Get it). The desktop 'Voice' topic is dictation, while on the phone 'Voice mode' means spoken conversation.
risk: Desktop users think spoken chat needs a phone and Pro. 'Voice' means two different things across products.
rec: shared: add a voice highlight to the desktop 'chat' topic. Rename the desktop Pro topic 'Dictation' to match the change map and the phone 'Speech to text'.

screen: Phone guide topics Vault, Notes, 'Your chats, on every device'
title: Guide promises sync that is off by default
what: phone-vault says 'Paired, it stays the same on your computer'. phone-sync says copied text stays current. The checked flows say vault sharing is 'Off by default' and copied text moves only 'after you turn this on'. The guide topic and its 'Open Vault' / 'Open Clipboard' button never say so.
risk: A user pairs, expects passwords and clipboard on the other device, sees nothing, and gets no reason or switch.
rec: shared: change the copy to 'when you turn on Vault sharing'. mobile: give the Vault and Clipboard headers the sync state control the desktop got (8c6399065).

screen: Desktop guide topic Images -> 'Open Images' -> memory-chat
title: Open Images lands on a plain chat
what: Images routes to 'memory-chat', the same as Chat. It does not check for an image model or open an image mode. The phone does both: with no image model it opens Models on the Image tab.
risk: A desktop user with no image model asks for a picture and gets a text reply. No next step.
rec: desktop: route Images to the image mode of chat, or to Models filtered to image when none is downloaded, like useGuideAction 'images'.

screen: Extension: no 'What it does for you' surface
title: Extension has no guide for its 74 flows
what: The knowledge base holds 74 checked extension flows and 15 not-supported answers. Only the desktop and phone guides answer them, prefixed 'In the browser extension:'. The change map lists 'guide' as missing on extension.
risk: A user in the browser panel cannot ask how to fill, pair or run a task. They must switch to the desktop app.
rec: browser-extension: add an Ask/guide screen over GuideSurface 'extension' using guideFlowAnswer. shared: add the 'extension' surface.

title: Scribe topic opens Notes; controls say Improve
what: The Scribe topic's button reads 'Open Notes'. Every flow calls the feature 'Improve' (Improve this paragraph, Share > Improve, Improve the selected text). Nothing on the phone is labelled Scribe.
risk: A user looks for Scribe, lands in Notes, and finds no screen with that name.
rec: shared: label the phone topic 'Improve' (or put 'Scribe' on the Improve sheet). mobile: open the Improve sheet or a chat, not Notes.

screen: Phone guide topic 'Your chats, on every device' -> 'Open Devices'
title: Button says Devices; phone screen is Sync
what: The button reads 'Open Devices'. The phone's row and every phone flow say Settings > Sync ('Sync with Pro' without Pro). The desktop screen is 'Devices and sync'.
risk: Three names for one feature. The guide's own steps ('Settings > Sync') do not match its button.
rec: mobile: change the label to 'Open Sync'.

screen: Desktop guide topic 'God' (route explore); phone flow desktop-task 'Assistant'
title: One assistant, three names: God, Ares, Assistant
what: The Pro catalog labels it 'God'. Its description says 'Chat or talk with Ares'. Feature parts call it 'Assistant'. The phone flow says '(in a chat) > Assistant' with a paired desktop.
risk: Users cannot connect the phone's Assistant to the desktop's God. Search and Ask match one name only.
rec: desktop + shared: pick one user-facing name and use it in the catalog label, feature parts and phone flow. Keep Ares as the wake word only.

screen: Desktop guide topics 'Browser extension', 'Vault in the browser' -> 'Get it'
title: Guide says Firefox; link is Chrome only
what: The topic says 'Add Off Grid AI to Chrome or Firefox'. GUIDE_LINKS.extension is the Chrome Web Store only, for both topics.
risk: Firefox users follow 'Get it' to a store that cannot install it.
rec: shared: point 'extension' at a getoffgridai.co page that picks the store by browser.

screen: Phone guide topic Scribe; desktop guide topic 'Off Grid AI on your phone'
title: Guide says Share menu; Android uses selection menu
what: Both topics say to improve text 'from the Share menu'. The Android flow is the text selection menu 'Improve'. Share > Improve is iPhone only.
risk: Android users look in Share and do not find it.
rec: shared: say 'from the text menu (Android) or Share (iPhone)'.
